q: In August 2025, what was the nightly lodging cap for a grade 2 traveller going to a band B2 destination? Answer under the version of the overseas per-diem that was in force on that date.
log:
The nightly lodging cap for a Grade 2 traveller to a Band B2 destination, under the version in force in August 2025 (hard-perdiem-v2, 2024-07-01 to 2025-12-31), is **115 USD**.

DONE
